sb_prompt: DISCUSS THE WEATHER.   WHAT HAS IT BEEN LIKE IN YOUR AREA?   HAS IT BEEN TYPICAL FOR THIS TIME OF YEAR?  COMPARE IT WITH THE OTHER CALLER'S WEATHER.

Yeah, I have. We seem to be getting more extreme weather patterns, like heavier rain and stronger winds.
Yeah, that's been happening a lot lately. It's definitely something to be concerned about.
Definitely. I think it's important for us to do our part in reducing our impact on the environment.

Those are great ideas. I try to do similar things, too. Have you noticed any changes in the weather that have affected your daily life?
Not really, but I have noticed that extreme weather events seem to be happening more frequently.
Yeah, it's definitely something to be concerned about. What do you think we can do as individuals to help address this issue?
I think we can all make small changes in our daily lives to help reduce our impact on the environment. Even small changes can make a big difference when we all do them.
That's true. It's important for us to do our part and be mindful of our impact on the environment. Well, it was nice talking to you.
It was nice talking to you too. Take care!
